cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Test the Impossible Claim
cards.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tap for the invisible bridge with your umbrella before I cross this ditch. Remember all those streams I taught you to test? This one's just harder to see.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your umbrella extends. Keep your feet on the bank, like I showed you. No brave little extra step.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probe, but finding a surface doesn't mean it will hold you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're thinking about the next test. Slide your picnic basket onto it first. Leave my lunch inside; don't make the test easier than the job.
